description: This file defines a custom Blazor component 'CustomInputSelect<TValue>' that extends the 'InputSelect<TValue>' class to add support for parsing integers from string inputs, providing a workaround for a known limitation prior to .NET 5.0 regarding native support.

classes.name: CustomInputSelect<TValue>
classes.description: A custom input select component for Blazor that provides integer parsing support.

methods.name: TryParseValueFromString
methods.description: Overrides the base method to parse string values into the TValue type, with special handling for integers.
